title: Road Hazard Impact Credit — Alignment Services & Plans
content:
**Rule.** When a Road Hazard Protection certificate has recently paid a tire replacement on the vehicle, a road hazard impact credit is taken off the labor charged on the open work order of the vehicle's Alignment Services & Plans alignment plan. It is read from the replacements paid on the vehicle's active Road Hazard Protection certificate, by their damage type and service date. The credit is worked out on its own and taken off the labor charged, which is rounded to the nearest cent and never falls below 0.00.

| Replacements paid on the vehicle's active certificate with a service date no more than 7 calendar days before the visit | Credit |
|---|---|
| At least one for impact-break damage | 10.00 |
| One or more for other damage, none for impact-break damage | 5.00 |
| None within those 7 days, or no active certificate | 0.00 |

**Input — judgement — output (hypothetical certificates):**
- impact-break replacement serviced 7 days before the visit → within the 7 days → 10.00;
- impact-break replacement serviced 8 days before, other-damage replacement 3 days before → only other damage within the 7 days → 5.00;
- a repair (not a replacement) 2 days before → no replacement → 0.00;
- the certificate is no longer active → 0.00.
